title: Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple, Simhachalam
scope: The named hilltop Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple enclosure, west Raja Gopuram, axial sanctum, portico and halls, courtyard structures and enclosed granite verandah.
limitations: The enclosure, central building footprint and four courtyard ranges are mapped. The tower, colonnade and entrance proportions are estimated from the two published photographs and architectural descriptions.
The west gopuram is centered on the temple axis. The photo GPS establishes the general approach and approximate viewing distance. Local survey dimensions are unavailable.
Individual stone carvings, religious figures and inscriptions are simplified. Interiors and detached approach facilities remain outside the model scope.
